dialogues.speaker: Jeht
dialogues.text: #Here's a thousand hugs, {NICKNAME}! We will meet again!

dialogues.speaker: Jeht
dialogues.text: And Paimon too! I didn't expect to run into you two here!

dialogues.speaker: Jeht
dialogues.text: Haha, keep it down! You're gonna scare my fish away!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh... You're fishing? But why aren't you using a fishing rod?

dialogues.speaker: Jeht
dialogues.text: #Benben, that's not true! Anyway... Why don't we talk about something else, {NICKNAME}?

choices.text: So, about that fishing rod of yours...

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: You...!

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: It... broke — totally its own fault, though... Hehe.

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: *sigh* I never thought fishing would be this different from hunting. Seriously, why is it so difficult? I hadn't the patience to sit here for hours waiting for them to bite my bait. So I thought, "why don't I just jump into the river and catch them myself"?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But you didn't catch any in the end, did you?

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: Hmph, of course I did. I got a really big one, and it's longer than you by... Um, the length of half a Benben!

response.speaker: Benben
response.text: Beep! Beep!

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: I grilled it and ate it, so there's none left for you.

response.speaker: Benben
response.text: Beep...?

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: Yup, Benben also had its share. You're the only one who got left out!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Like Paimon's gonna believe that fib!

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: Hahaha! Your loss!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: How have you been?

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: Huh? Good, don't you worry about me.

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: It's not the first time that I've traveled alone...

response.speaker: Benben
response.text: Beep! Beep!

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: Hahaha, there there, I know I have you!

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: After my fallout with the Tanit, the various desert tribes stopped providing me with food and shelter... I'm no longer under any tribe's protection.

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: Later... Rukh Shah from the Corps of Thirty offered me a place in the city, but... I didn't feel comfortable there. It reminded me too much of my mother...

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: So I left Sumeru City. Thought I'd travel to another nation and check out some beautiful places I'd never seen before.

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: So I boarded a merchant ship and somehow ended up here.

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: And after that... Well, there's nothing new to share after that, haha! You know how bodyguards are always needed in every corner of the world, right? Well, that's especially so in big cities like this where merchant caravans come and go every day. So yeah, I'm living alright.

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: Hehe, and well, this is fine. I quite enjoy the life I have now, adrift and unattached.

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: Me and Benben are just like you and Paimon, aren't we?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmph, Benben is no match for Paimon!

response.speaker: Benben
response.text: Beep-beep!

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: #Hahaha, no fighting, you two... Well, I won't keep you any longer, {NICKNAME}. I had planned to treat you to a big meal, but us guards-for-hire have rules we need to follow... *sigh*

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: Ahem! So much for complaining! Let me give you a thousand hugs and wish you a pleasant journey ahead!

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: #{M#Our paths will converge one day! Don't you forget that, eh?}{F#...Don't forget what I said to you back at the Tanit tribe. If you ever feel tired or want to take a breather... Perhaps our paths might converge then.}

choices.text: I didn't expect to see you here.

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: Yeah... I wasn't expecting to see you either. What a neat surprise!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe, hope we didn't interrupt your fishin— Uh, fish-catching, did we?

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: Knock it off, little Paimon!
